dedupe_keys.name: a database of shake table tests conducted on unreinforced masonry buildings

description: This database assembles results from 69 shake-table experiments on unreinforced masonry buildings conducted over several decades. A consistent description of test configurations and results supports model validation and comparison across experiments. The provider also links an interactive database containing equivalent-frame models; those models are not independently assessed in this record. The dataset is provided by Mathias Haindl; Katrin Beyer; Ian F.C. Smith through BED. BED assigns this collection to 2023; the constituent tests span separate campaigns. The provider metadata identifies documentation, analysis code, spreadsheets. Zenodo lists open file access with no stated charge. Actual file retrieval was not tested. BED currently reports that its dataset download was not found; the separate Zenodo metadata is retained. The stated licence is CC BY 4.0. The collection supports comparisons and calibration of infrastructure response models. Test protocols and measurement resolution vary; file-level quality remains unverified. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
